verse.verse_6: And by the sea that is Masjur.
verse.verse_7: Verily, the torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.
verse.verse_8: There is none that can avert it.
verse.verse_9: On the Day when Tamur the heaven Mawr,
verse.verse_11: Then woe that Day to those who denied.
verse.verse_12: Those who were, in their falsehood, playing.
verse.verse_13: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.
verse.verse_14: This is the Fire which you used to deny.
verse.verse_15: Is this magic or do you not see
verse.verse_16: Enter therein and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.
verse.verse_17: Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in Gardens and Delight.
verse.verse_18: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.
verse.verse_19: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."
verse.verse_20: They will recline on thrones Masfufah. And We shall marry them to Hur (fair females) with wide lovely eyes.
verse.verse_21: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in faith, -- to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.
verse.verse_22: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
verse.verse_23: There they shall pass from hand to hand a cup, free from any idle talk, and free from sin.
verse.verse_24: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.
verse.verse_25: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.
verse.verse_26: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid in the midst of our families."
verse.verse_27: "So Allah has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire."
verse.verse_28: "Verily, We used to invoke Him before. Verily, He is the Most Subtle, the Most Merciful."
verse.verse_29: Therefore, remind. By the grace of Allah, you are neither a Kahin nor a madman.
verse.verse_30: Or do they say: "A poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"
verse.verse_31: Say: "Wait! I am with you among those who wait!"
verse.verse_32: Or do their minds command them this or are they people transgressing all bounds
verse.verse_33: Or do they say: "He has forged it" Nay! They believe not!
verse.verse_34: Let them then produce a recitation like unto it if they are truthful.
verse.verse_35: Or were they created by nothing Or were they themselves the creators
verse.verse_36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth Nay, but they have no firm belief.
verse.verse_37: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like
verse.verse_38: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.
verse.verse_39: Or has He only daughters and you have sons
verse.verse_40: Or is it that you ask a wage from them so that they are burdened with a load of debt
verse.verse_41: Or that the Unseen is with them, and they write it down
verse.verse_42: Or do they intend a plot But those who disbelieve are themselves plotted against!
verse.verse_43: Or have they a god other than Allah Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partners.
verse.verse_44: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
verse.verse_45: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).
verse.verse_46: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
verse.verse_47: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment before this; but most of them know not.
verse.verse_48: So wait patiently for the decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the praises of your Lord when you get up.
verse.verse_49: And in the nighttime also glorify His praises and at the setting of the stars.
